summary.answer: Creates shared Director select screen with extra-home left/right filtered lists, featured playlists, mode list, safe-area/description and PC/Korea/tier-notification children. List callbacks refresh labels on lock/trial/lobby changes and descriptions on focus. Extra/mode trial-store branches containing AlwaysFalse are retained as inactive source predicates; unlocked/show-for-all/not-trial actions process the list and return true. Featured prioritizes trial store, unlocked action, missing-DLC overlay, ZM store, season-pass upsell and locked action. Mode locked action is PC-gated. Focus/lose-focus shows/hides tier notification. Safe-area menu_loaded sizes console and dispatches when unhandled. Korea event controls use exact active-event branches. State predicates distinguish live online demo/arena/default and LAN demo/arena/default. Close/postload precede pass-custom-function, UGC validation, WZ trial-video and PC redirect navigation setup. No effective playlist choice, store action, account state or native loader/runtime is asserted.
